notes: New: Steady players in Ryujinx (Settings › Controllers). The launcher holds a virtual controller for each player during the game, so a controller dying mid-game no longer shuffles the players; when it's back on it takes its spot again. Needs the free ViGEmBus driver (installed from the same place, Windows asks once) and a one-time setup with Ryujinx. Off until you turn it on.
